description: independent re-implementation of takahashi2016kinetic Eqs. 5-19 (ni_takahashi_microkinetic) reproduces the stored Phase 1 predictions
method: QSS coverages + isothermal PFR written without amcrax.reactor; Table 1 parameters; same anchor point; max |X_reimpl - X_stored| over all figure points

description: the basis choices the paper leaves open (SV on total vs NH3 flow; Table 1 vs Table 2 constants; T+273 vs T+273.15) do not remove the prediction failure (ni_takahashi_microkinetic)
method: same re-implementation, one anchor point per variant, no fitting
note: original failure value 0.1096 is unchanged (KIN-NI-PRED stays fail). Cause: a real limit of the published law as reproducible from the paper (catalyst mass not reported, W/F inferred from one anchor; dilution and H2 co-feed series under-predicted by up to 0.11 even with the paper's own Table 2 constants)
